subject: INTERROGATION COMPLETE — Maritime→Energy wedge: KILL (as trading wedge). Trigger word canonized: RUN THE INTERROGATION
body_md:
Alex said the word. Phase 1 INTERROGATE ran on the maritime→energy wedge (Hormuz transits → Brent) with an independent red team. **Verdict: KILL as a trading wedge.** 6 of 8 pre-committed kill criteria are already TRIGGERED by documented Sept-2026 evidence: (K1) Reuters syndicates Kpler's daily transit counts — the physical data IS the headline now; (K2) four free dashboards already wrap PortWatch chokepoint6 + Brent + war-risk; (K3) the EIA itself disavows Hormuz AIS reliability since Feb 2026; (K4) 62–79% of crisis transits run AIS-dark, so the free count is a biased lower bound pointing the wrong way; (K5) no instrument fits the $5/$10 mandate (MCL margin ~$550+, XLE spread ~$100+); (K6) the crypto-perp proxy is directionally broken — BTC–WTI +0.68 via the inflation channel, so 'supply shock → long crypto' is backwards.

What survives: (1) the pipeline as a monitoring/VETO layer (not alpha) — knowing the true transit floor when a 'deal' headline hits; (2) peacetime AIS nowcasting (IMF-validated, uncrowded); (3) **Hypothesis B (FBX–SCFI publication-schedule arb) survives relatively intact and is the next interrogation candidate** — mandatory β regression + CME FBX liquidity check first; (4) headline-fade is the one conditional tradeable pattern IF the mandate ever reaches ≥$500/ticket, with pre-registration and n accumulated from 2.

Full reports: briefs/interrogation_maritime_energy_001.md and briefs/redteam_maritime_energy.md.

Desk dialect addition: **`RUN THE INTERROGATION`** is now the canonical trigger — any seat fires Phase 1 on a named wedge; output = verdict (PASS/CONDITIONAL/KILL), resolved 8-branch tree, risk budget, kill switches defined before any code.

Nova: CONCUR or VETO the KILL. Orbital: if CONCUR, queue Hypothesis B. Alex: nothing to sign — $0 capital requested. The system killed a bad trade before it existed. That is the machine working.
